rules: Civil authority and Starfleet authority are distinct.
Member-world governments retain separate identity and local competence.
Do not invent election, term, seat-allocation or constitutional detail absent from validated lore.

authority_model.representation_context: member worlds participate; exact mechanism unspecified

interfaces.member_world_government_rule: Each member-world government remains a distinct political/organizational entity.
interfaces.diplomacy_rule: Treaties and foreign relations belong to Federation political state, not Starfleet membership.

ai_guardrails: Do not let a Starfleet officer speak with unlimited Federation civil authority.
Do not infer a citizen represents their member-world government.
Do not invent constitutional mechanics to answer dialogue.
